name: berk-karaal
description: Berk Karaal's plugins for Claude Code and OpenCode V2.

plugins.name: task-tracker
plugins.description: Local-only persistent task tracking: .tasks/ docs + /task-tracker:* commands

plugins.name: notification
plugins.description: Push notifications when Claude finishes a task, hits an error, or needs input

plugins.name: wt-hub
plugins.description: Clone or convert a repository into a Worktrunk-managed worktree hub, and clean up merged or stale worktrees

plugins.name: brk-pr
plugins.description: GitHub PR workflow: /brk-pr:review-loop works through review feedback until the PR is mergeable, /brk-pr:update-branch merges the base branch into the PR branch
